resources.string: These controls open Android settings. The checked state follows the permission currently granted by the device.
Manage system permissions used by SafeMobile protection.
Keep the background sentinel eligible to run.
Allow urgent threat warnings to appear over other apps.

SafeMobile uses Android Device Administrator only for optional force-lock and password-policy controls. It does not read your personal files, messages, or contacts. Android still lets you deactivate the administrator before uninstalling SafeMobile; this is not tamper-proof protection and does not block APK installation.

SafeMobile uses this optional special access only to display high-priority threat alerts over other apps. Overlay windows can obscure controls in other apps. It does not grant access to your personal files or messages. Enable it only if you want these alerts.
Overlay Alerts are optional. No overlay access is requested during onboarding; enable the feature later in Security Guards.
Monitor only folders explicitly granted through the Android file picker.
Inspect verified benchmark information and local scan analytics.
